real_vllm_cross_check.construction: mirrors vLLM's own tests/v1/core/utils.py create_scheduler: real ModelConfig(Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct) + SchedulerConfig(watermark=0.0) + CacheConfig + KVCacheConfig(FullAttentionSpec) + register_all_kvcache_specs + real Scheduler + real block pool; ⑤ beat driven through the REAL update_from_output with hand-built ModelRunnerOutput (empty sampled list for non-final prefill chunks — exactly how the real engine reports them); VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=0 to exercise the MRV1 path the trimmed version implements
real_vllm_cross_check.scenarios: 63 checks / 13 scenario groups — decode steady state exactly 1 token/step over 3 steps (computed 17/18/19); 8192-token prompt -> exactly [2048,2048,2048,2048] chunks driven through the RUNNING phase with is_prefill_chunk True/True/True/False and _inflight_prefills membership flipping on the final chunk, computed==8192 at end; long_prefill_token_threshold=1024 clamps BOTH the WAITING first chunk and the RUNNING resume; mixed batch 2 decode x 1 + new 8192 -> {d1:1,d2:1,big:2046}, total exactly 2048, dichotomy 2 cached + 1 new; chunked-off whole-step break (config-valid variant: budget==max_model_len==2048, decode eats 1, 2048-prompt > 2047 left -> WAITING phase breaks, request stays WAITING in queue); PAUSED_ALL -> total 0, waiting untouched; 4-block pool (3 usable after null block) -> FCFS preempts running tail r2 (computed reset 0, num_preemptions 1, back at waiting HEAD via prepend, out.preempted_req_ids=={r2}, preempted step admits nobody); resumed request goes scheduled_resumed_reqs with resumed_req_ids=={r2} and FULL all_token_ids (17 = 16 prompt + 1 output — the num_tokens-not-num_prompt_tokens rationale) while previously-scheduled requests get diff only; WAITING admission failure (2-block victim, 1 free) never preempts in-flight r1, preempted_req_ids empty; max_num_seqs=1 caps admission at len(running); full_sequence_must_fit=True rejects a 1000-token prompt on a 2-usable-block pool while False admits exactly the 32-token first chunk with is_prefill_chunk=True; first schedule emits NewRequestData full payload (prompt + computed=0 + block_ids), second step CachedRequestData diff only (all_token_ids empty because prev-step scheduled, computed=[16]); REAL prefix-caching path: request b with identical 300-token prefix after a finished+cached hits exactly 288 tokens (18 full blocks) and schedules only 12, b.num_computed_tokens==300 (288 hit folded at admission + 12 optimistic advance — the exact pattern the trimmed stubbed test asserts as 64+192==256)
